paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.92, with a decrease of 0.84% from the prior close and 10.03% over the last 23 sessions. The price quote is as of August 21, 2026.

Recent news headlines include statements from Fermi CEO Lee McIntire regarding the impact of Texas Governor Abbott's pause on data center development on Project Matador, as well as the company's receipt of a US subpoena related to the project. Other news includes the appointment of Lee McIntire as interim CEO and updates on construction at the Project Matador campus.

There have been 25 total filings, including 2 Form 4 filings and 11 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include an insider transaction report, a 10-Q report disclosing a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K filing announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as CEO with an annualized base salary of $750,000.
